paragraphs: Today, we're diving into 26 trending self-hosted projects from media managers to automation tools and everything in between. Let's get started.

Cinephage, an all-in-one self-hosted media management app built for people who devour movies and TV. Instead of juggling five different tools, Cinephage handles discovery, downloading, organizing, and subtitles all in one app. You can browse TMDB trending movies and shows, search public and private indexers, score releases by quality, and automatically send downloads to qBittorrent. Once files land, Cinephage automates metadata and keeps monitoring for missing episodes or quality upgrades.

Papra, the minimalist document management and archiving platform. Papra lets you store and organize your documents with zero hassle. Whether it's that old gift receipt or important contract, you can upload and retrieve documents in an instant. It's a digital archive that's simple and designed for long-term document storage. You can create organizations to manage documents with family. It features full text search and even content extraction from scanned images for easy searching.

Zerobyte, a backup automation platform built specifically for self-hosters. It takes the power of Restic and wraps it in a clean modern web interface for scheduling, managing, and monitoring your backups. Zerobyte lets you run fully automated encrypted backups with compression and retention policies so your data stays safe without constant babysitting. You can set fine-grained schedules, monitor backup health, and protect your data with end-to-end encryption by default.

Open Archiver, a secure platform for legally compliant email archiving. It's built for organizations that need a permanent tamperproof record of email communication without vendor lock-in. Open Archiver can ingest emails from Gmail, Microsoft 365, IMAP inboxes, and even zipped email archives, handling both bulk imports and real-time syncing. Emails are stored in standard EML format, deduplicated with support for local storage or S3 compatible backends.

Pangolin combines a VPN and a reverse proxy into one clean open-source system for accessing anything anywhere. Pangolin lets you securely connect remote sites and private networks without public IPs or open ports using lightweight site connectors for web apps. It provides browser-based access with authentication and load balancing all without exposing your network to the internet.

Little Link, a self-hosted alternative to Linktree that developers absolutely love. It lets you build a clean link in bio page you can host anywhere. No accounts, no tracking, no monthly fees. Little Link comes with over 100 branded button styles, plus light and dark themes right out of the box. And if you want custom buttons, the new Little Link button builder lets you design them visually. In fact, we use Little Link ourselves for our channel's link page, and it's been rock solid.

IronCalc, a modern open-source spreadsheet engine built in Rust. It's not just another spreadsheet app. It's a high-performance engine and ecosystem you can embed anywhere. IronCalc is fast with minimal dependencies and it even runs in the browser via WebAssembly. It supports Excel-compatible import and export, hundreds of spreadsheet functions, tables, and a roadmap that aims to rival full-featured spreadsheet software.

Arcane, a modern Docker management platform designed for everyone. It gives you a beautiful, intuitive web interface to manage Docker without living in the terminal. With Arcane, you can start, stop, restart, and inspect containers, manage images, configure networks, and handle volumes, all from a clean, responsive UI. You also get real-time monitoring, live logs, and visual graphs for CPU, memory, and network usage, so you always know what your containers are doing.

Beszel, a lightweight self-hosted server monitoring platform built for simplicity. It gives you a clean web dashboard with historical metrics, Docker container stats, and built-in alerts without the overhead of heavyweight monitoring stacks. Beszel tracks CPU, memory, disk, and load, plus detailed per-container Docker usage over time. You can set up alerts for pretty much everything that matters, from bandwidth spikes to offline systems.

Media Manager, a self-hosted media management system for your TV and movie library. Designed as a replacement for Sonarr, Radarr, and Jellyfin, it lets you organize, track, and manage all your media effortlessly. Media Manager integrates with TVDB and TMDB for rich metadata, supports OIDC and OAuth 2.0 for secure authentication, and connects with Prowlarr and Jackett for automated content discovery.

This is LoggiFly, a lightweight tool that monitors your Docker container logs and sends instant alerts. It watches for predefined keywords or regex patterns in logs and notifies you via ntfy or over 100 channels like Slack or Telegram. LoggiFly is perfect for catching security breaches, debugging crashes, or even automatically restarting or stopping containers on critical events.

Listing Lab, a self-hosted workspace for tracking homes you're interested in. It's perfect for keeping property listings organized, adding notes, tagging photos, and sharing short lists with friends or family. Listing Lab keeps an eye on changes like price drops or status updates, so your view of a property is always up to date without constantly refreshing websites.

Pulse, a real-time monitoring dashboard for Proxmox VE, Docker, and Kubernetes. It's designed as a single pane of glass for sysadmins and MSPs who want full visibility without the complexity of enterprise stacks. Pulse lets you monitor nodes, containers, clusters, backups, and storage with persistent metrics history and smart alerts via Discord, Telegram, email, and more.

PatchMon, a simple self-hosted Linux patch monitoring and management platform. It provides centralized visibility across your servers, helping you keep packages up to date while eliminating inbound ports for security. PatchMon features a customizable dashboard and detailed package tracking across hosts. Its agents are outbound only, collecting data safely without exposing your servers.

Poznote, a lightweight self-hosted notetaking and documentation platform. It lets you capture, organize, and access your notes while keeping full ownership of your data. Poznote comes with a rich text editor, markdown support, task lists, and diagram integrations like Excalidraw and Mermaid. You can attach files, use tags, search across notes, and even share content publicly when needed.

Sync-in, a self-hosted platform for file storage, sharing, collaboration, and syncing. It gives you full control over your data while offering a modern interface for both internal and external users. Sync-in supports collaborative spaces and activity tracking. You can edit documents in real time via OnlyOffice integration, search files with full text indexing, and manage storage quotas or locked spaces for sensitive documents.

Upvote RSS, a self-hosted platform for generating rich, customizable RSS feeds from popular social aggregation sites. It supports Reddit, Hacker News, and GitHub, letting you pull posts from communities, subreddits, or repositories directly into your feed reader. Upvote RSS can embed media like videos and images, extract clean content with featured images, and even generate AI-powered summaries using providers like OpenAI and more.

Posterizarr, an automated poster and artwork generator for your media library. It's a PowerShell-based tool with a full web UI, letting you fetch textless artwork from TMDB, Plex, and IMDb, and apply custom overlays or text for a polished look. Posterizarr supports Plex, Jellyfin, and Emby, and integrates with tools like Tautulli and Radarr to automatically trigger updates when new media arrives.

This is BackVault, a lightweight Dockerized service for automated secure backups of your Bitwarden or Vaultwarden vaults. It periodically exports your vault using your credentials, storing password-protected AES encrypted backup files for full security. BackVault supports interval-based or cron-based scheduling, automatic cleanup of old backups, and two encryption modes.

Warracker, a self-hosted warranty tracker for individuals and teams. It makes organizing product warranties, tracking expiration dates, and storing receipts or manuals simple and centralized. It features multiple serial number support, proactive alerts via email or over 100 push services, and full warranty claim management. You can also search and import warranty data with multi-user support and role-based permissions for teams.

Tinyauth is a simple way to add authentication to your apps. It provides a lightweight login screen or OAuth support for Google, GitHub, and other providers, protecting your self-hosted apps in minutes. Tinyauth is designed for simplicity. Configure it with just environment variables. No dashboards or complex config files needed. It works seamlessly with popular proxies like Nginx and Caddy.

Dispatcharr is your self-hosted IPTV and stream management companion. Think of it as the IPTV family's cousin designed to give you full control over your streams and VOD content. Dispatcharr supports M3U imports, playlist filtering, VOD management, while its proxy streaming engine optimizes bandwidth and improves reliability. The platform also provides real-time stats dashboards and output compatibility for Plex and Jellyfin.

This is Journiv, a self-hosted journaling app designed to keep your thoughts and memories entirely yours. It combines mood tracking, prompt-based journaling, and advanced search in a clean, minimal interface. Journiv emphasizes privacy, so there's no telemetry or data collection. Your journal stays on your machine under your control. It includes mood visualizations, multiple journals, and 'on this day' memories.

TimeTracker, a web-based time tracking and project management platform. It allows you to track time, manage projects, and generate invoices, all while maintaining full control over your data. TimeTracker boasts over 130 features across 13 major categories, including security. If you want a comprehensive, professional, and self-hosted tool to manage time, projects, and billing efficiently, TimeTracker is your all-in-one solution.

Pocket ID, a simple OIDC provider built for passwordless authentication. Unlike heavy solutions like Keycloak or Ory Hydra, Pocket ID focuses on simplicity and ease of use, providing everything you need to authenticate users securely. What makes Pocket ID special is its passkey-only approach. No passwords required. Users can log in with devices like YubiKeys or platform pass keys, making authentication both secure and frictionless.

Godoxy, a lightweight reverse proxy with a sleek web UI built for self-hosters who want speed and simplicity. It's Docker-aware, automatically detecting your containers and configuring routes without lifting a finger. Idle containers, no problem. Godoxy can put them to sleep and wake them up only when needed, saving resources. Need control? Fine-tune access per IP, domain, and monitor your servers with live CPU, memory, and disk stats.
